description.narrative: The project will (i) construct a new two-lane bypass road of 16.2 km skirting Batumi; and (ii) contract out routine and periodic maintenance work for about 200 km of international roads combined with connecting secondary roads based on performance-based maintenance (PBM) contract. Batumi is a major port city in the southwest part of Georgia, bordered by the Black Sea to the west and Turkey to the south. The existing main road connecting Sarpi at the border with Turkey to Poti, a major port at the Black Sea, is a key transit route along the coastline of the Black Sea for heavy goods and passenger traffic from Turkey to Tbilisi and then onto Azerbaijan and the Caspian Sea.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3520: 88% of contracts awarded and 82% disbursed as of 20 Jun 2025
Loan 8328: 79% of contracts awarded and 69% disbursed as of 20 Jun 2025
Progress Toward Outcome: Estimated progress of executed works as of 31 December 2023: (i) Batumi Bypass Road - 82%, (ii) Poti Bridge and Access Roads - 27%, and (iii) Bakurtsikhe-Tsnori Road - 57%.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Aug 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50064/50064-001-apfs-en_5.pdf
Some results are in the Environmental Impact Assessments | Jun 2019: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50064/50064-001-eia-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Jun 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50064/50064-001-iee-en_0.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Aug 2019: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50064/50064-001-rp-en_0.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Apr 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/50064/50064-001-smr-en_25.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: 1. Batumi Bypass Road. Critical path activities for the tunnels and bridges are ongoing. The Works are expected to be completed by May 2024.
2. The final design report under Activity II for the Batumi Bypass Sarpi Road is expected to be delivered by June 2024.
3a. Poti Bridge and Access Roads. Works on the access roads, abutments, relocation of utilities, reinforcement steel works, and excavation and transportation of soil/aggregates are ongoing. The new design of the substructure of the main bridge has been approved. The Works are expected to be completed by May 2024.
3b. Bakurtsikhe-Tsnori Road. Concrete structures were mostly completed while embankments fill works and relocation of gas pipelines are ongoing. The Works are expected to be completed by March 2024.
